name: Tool-call sampling variants
command: ssh -o BatchMode=yes luigi@raspberrypi.tailf63b31.ts.net 'cd ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/asm && S=$(echo ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--google--functiongemma-270m-it/snapshots/*/model.safetensors) && for A in "700 950" "1000 500"; do set -- $A; timeout 200 ./core $S ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcvocab.bin 2 f ~/PULSAR-ARM/pulsar_arm/fcbpe.bin $1 $2 < /tmp/tool_official.txt > /tmp/tool_$1_$2.log 2>&1; echo "T$1-P$2 EXIT=$?"; awk "/^tpl:/{f=1} f" /tmp/tool_$1_$2.log | tail -n +2 | head -6 | cut -c1-60; done'
